title: 第一卷 · 霓虹失名者 / 第一章 1.1 雨夜追踪
description: 原创像素冒险 · 四级基础→四级较难 · 4 道分段听力题
source: 原创剧情与配套听力题；词汇选取参考四六级常见场景，不是考试原文。
audioLabel: 自然英文神经网络配音：星遥 Michelle / 陆川 Brian / 旁白 Christopher / 系统 Guy · 原创非考试原音
ending: 本节行动结果已记录。前往主线地图查看路线，或重新闯关尝试另一种道具选择。
questionNote: 原创四六级听力风格题；每段结束作答一次，共 4 题。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Rain strikes the street. A red light follows me through the smoke.
lines.translation: 雨水敲打空荡的街道。一束红光穿过烟雾，紧紧追着我。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Keep your head down. That screen is scanning your face, not showing an advertisement.
lines.translation: 低下头。那块屏幕在扫描你的脸，不是在播放广告。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Why would it scan me? I have only just arrived in this city.
lines.translation: 它为什么要扫描我？我才刚来到这座城市。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: There is no record of your identity. Here, that makes you a security risk.
lines.translation: 系统里没有你的身份记录。在这里，这就意味着你是安全风险。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: So I am in trouble because the system cannot find my name?
lines.translation: 所以，系统找不到我的名字，就认为我有问题？

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Exactly. Follow me before the patrol arrives. Ask questions somewhere safer.
lines.translation: 没错。巡逻队赶来前跟我走。找个安全的地方再问。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: The main station is nearby. Could we ask the staff for assistance there?
lines.translation: 主车站就在附近。我们能去找工作人员帮忙吗？

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Every entrance requires official permission. Without it, the gates will report your location.
lines.translation: 每个入口都需要正式授权。没有权限，闸机会报告你的位置。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: What is our alternative? This street seems blocked at both ends.
lines.translation: 那还有什么办法？这条街的两端似乎都被封锁了。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: An old maintenance passage runs below the shops. It leads to an abandoned platform.
lines.translation: 商店下面有一条旧维修通道，通往废弃站台。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Does the passage have cameras as well? I would rather avoid another alarm.
lines.translation: 通道里也有摄像头吗？我可不想再触发一次警报。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Not working ones. The equipment failed months ago. Nobody repaired it.
lines.translation: 有，但早就坏了。设备几个月前就出了故障，也没人来修。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: A steel door blocks the stairs. She checks the terminal, then shakes her head.
lines.translation: 一扇铁门挡住楼梯。她检查了终端，随后摇了摇头。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: The lock has power, but its control circuit is damaged. My tools cannot restore it.
lines.translation: 锁还有电，但控制电路损坏了。我的工具修不好。

lines.speaker: 万象系统
lines.text: Local fault identified. Remote repair available. Confirm activation to restore the damaged circuit.
lines.translation: 已识别局部故障。远程修复可用。确认启动，即可恢复损坏的电路。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Confirmed. Stand back. I can handle this problem.
lines.translation: 确认启动。离门远一点。我想，这个问题我能解决。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: It is opening. You did not even touch the terminal. What exactly did you do?
lines.translation: 门开了。你连终端都没碰。你到底做了什么？

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Repaired the circuit. I will explain when we are no longer being followed.
lines.translation: 修好了电路。等没人追我们的时候，我再解释。

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Fair enough. I am Xingyao, a reporter. And I owe you an explanation too.
lines.translation: 也对。我叫星遥，是记者。我也欠你一个解释。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Lu Chuan. If you are a reporter, why are you hiding from the patrol?
lines.translation: 陆川。如果你是记者，为什么要躲着巡逻队？

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: I found evidence that citizens are losing their identities. My sister disappeared during the investigation.
lines.translation: 我发现有居民的身份被删除。我妹妹在调查期间失踪了。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: You believe those events are connected, but you still need proof. Is that right?
lines.translation: 你认为这些事有联系，但还需要证据。对吗？

lines.speaker: 陈星遥
lines.text: Yes. Help me reach the shelter. I will show you what I found.
lines.translation: 对。帮我到地下避难所，我就给你看调查发现。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: She offers her hand. Behind us, the door closes before the red light returns.
lines.translation: 她向我伸出手。红光再次扫来之前，身后的门已经合上。

questions.prompt: Why is Lu Chuan being treated as a security risk?
options: He has damaged a public screen.
He has entered a restricted shop.
His identity cannot be found in the records.
He has refused to speak to the patrol.
questions.explanation: 第 4–5 句说明，陆川没有身份记录，因此被视为安全风险；不是因为他破坏设备或拒绝巡逻队。

questions.prompt: What does Xingyao suggest they do?
options: Ask the station staff for permission.
Take an unused passage beneath the shops.
Wait for someone to repair the cameras.
Leave through the main station entrance.
questions.explanation: 第 10 句建议走商店下方的维修通道；车站闸机会报告位置，所以不能从主入口走。

questions.prompt: What prevents the steel door from opening at first?
questions.explanation: 第 14 句明确说锁有电，但控制电路损坏。选项 B 把有电误写成完全断电。系统修复电路后门打开。

questions.prompt: What is Xingyao mainly trying to do?
options: Apply for a job at the station.
Investigate deleted identities and find her sister.
questions.explanation: 第 21–23 句表明星遥调查身份删除事件，并寻找失踪的妹妹。她需要证据，所以带男主去避难所继续调查。

itemScene: 城市扫描器找不到陆川的身份记录。星遥可以带路，却无法替他取得通行资格。完成本节词汇准备，再部署临时身份屏蔽器，才能争取穿过雨巷的短暂安全窗口。
